key_facts.answer: From Australia to the UAE you need an ISO microchip, a valid rabies vaccination, an Australian government export health certificate, and a MOCCAE import permit arranged before travel. There's no quarantine in the UAE when compliant — and none of the 180-day waiting that applies to moving INTO Australia.

sections.heading: Why it's easier than you expect
paragraphs: Australia's notoriously strict rules (rabies titre, 180-day wait, quarantine) apply to pets arriving IN Australia. Leaving Australia for the UAE doesn't involve them — Australia is rabies-free, so the export side is comparatively light. Confirm the current export-certificate process with Australia's agriculture department before booking.

sections.heading: The UAE side — the import permit
paragraphs: As for any origin, the UAE requires a MOCCAE import permit (before travel), the microchip and a valid rabies vaccination; compliant pets aren't quarantined. Confirm permit timing and your breed against the UAE restricted list — full detail on the Moving to Dubai hub.

story.lead: On Australia → Dubai, the only real risk is over-thinking it.
story.problem: An owner braces for the same months-long ordeal as moving into Australia.
story.mistake: They delay starting, assuming a huge lead time is needed.
story.discovery: The export side is light; the UAE permit is the main task.
story.result: Once they realise, the move comes together in weeks, not months.
story.lesson: Leaving Australia isn't the hard direction — focus your energy on the UAE permit and breed check.

faqs.q: Do I need the 180-day rabies wait to leave Australia?
faqs.a: No — that applies to pets entering Australia. Leaving Australia (rabies-free) for the UAE doesn't involve it. Confirm the export process with Australia's agriculture department.

faqs.q: Will my pet be quarantined in the UAE?
faqs.a: No — with a valid MOCCAE import permit, microchip and rabies vaccination, pets aren't quarantined on arrival. Confirm current MOCCAE rules.
Australia → Dubai is long-haul, so on Emirates your pet usually travels as manifest cargo (over the 17-hour baggage limit).

verified_100pct.fact: Australia's 180-day rabies wait applies to IMPORT into Australia

UAE import (MOCCAE): permit valid 90 days; permanent microchip matching the cert; rabies ≥21 days (first/lapsed dose, none for a valid booster); titre only from high-risk countries (≥0.5 IU/ml, valid 365d); min age 12wk (low-risk)/15wk (high-risk); internal+external parasite doses within 14 days; max 2 pets/person/year; fees AED 200 permit, AED 500/dog & AED 250/cat release; no quarantine if compliant
